preToolUse.bash:
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/runtime/hook.cjs" copilot || printf '%s
' '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'; else printf '%s
' 'PromptSift: Node unavailable; native agents remain active, read enforcement is inactive.' >&2; printf '%s
' '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'; fi
preToolUse.powershell: try { if (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/runtime/hook.cjs" copilot; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}' } } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('PromptSift: Node unavailable; native agents remain active, read enforcement is inactive.'); Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}' } } catch { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}' }; exit 0
